Vera Ortiz: Heads-up: Ignite enabled full reindex overnight and we see a big embeddings cost spike. Need a crisp mitigation + one-paragraph customer note for the QBR. cc @Ben
Ben Wallace: Pulling numbers. 48h burn = $15k, projected 30d = $225k if unchanged. They typically run ~$35k/mo. Credits remaining = $30k, retainer = $10k/mo (expires in 20 days).
Samir Gupta: Likely driver = bulk reindexing embeddings. Current breakdown: embeddings ~75%, query ~15%, other ~10%. Avg seq length ~900 tokens.
Aisha Khan: Customer said speed of ingestion is important but they accept short batching during ingest. They want predictability (no surprise bills).
billing-bot: Account IGNITE: credits=30000, monthly_retainer=10000, retainer_expiry=2026-04-05, auto_renew=false. ALERT: crossed 60% credits at 1747777600.
Vera Ortiz: For the QBR slide: 1) what happened (single line), 2) immediate mitigations we applied, 3) recommended next steps + enablement offer. Keep it non-technical for execs.
Ben Wallace: Draft quick auto-throttle policy for the slide: ```yaml
policy: budget_safety
soft_threshold: 20000
hard_threshold: 28000
soft_action: notify-cs + warn-customer
hard_action: pause-reindex + swap-to-quantized-embed
```
Ben Wallace: Scenarios (30d): status_quo = $225k, quantize+batch = $130k, pause-reindex = $80k. Notes: pause reduces ingestion speed.
Samir Gupta: Ops toggles for rollback/mitigation: ```bash
# swap indexer to quantized model and reduce concurrency
rwctl accounts set-model --account IGNITE --route embeddings --model open-embed-q4-8bit --batch-size 64
rwctl jobs update --account IGNITE --job reindex --concurrency 3
# pause reindex
rwctl jobs pause --account IGNITE --job reindex
# revert
rwctl jobs resume --account IGNITE --job reindex
rwctl accounts set-model --account IGNITE --route embeddings --model open-embed-fp16 --batch-size 256
```
Vera Ortiz: Action items: Ben - paste these three numbers + one-sparkline into the deck by EOD. Samir - prepare 2-line runbook + rollback commands. Aisha - draft 30m enablement invite (ingest tuning + monitoring window). I'll assemble slide and coordinate AE on commit ask. Meeting 16:00 to finalize. :thumbsup:
